timeCompression.why: Both Wait nodes are parameterless, so Wait v1.1 waits its default of 1 hour and n8n parks the execution in 'waiting' after the first poll, past the bench's timeout. Shortened to 1 second on both sides. This changes when the run resumes, not what it does: the mock's poll replies do not depend on elapsed time and no expression in the template reads $now. It is not a placeholder fill, so results flag it as time compression (config.nonPlaceholder).
